The turtle has a dark, oval-shaped carapace with visible scute patterns and some yellowish markings along the marginal scutes. The head is partially visible on the right side, showing a pointed snout and small eye. The limbs are tucked in or obscured by the shell and water refraction. The lighting creates strong reflections on the wet shell.
